assessment.headline: DAY 38. Deadline extended to TUESDAY. F-15E rescued. Green Sanvi at Mumbai. India buying Iranian oil. The most consequential week begins.
assessment.body:
Trump extended the Hormuz deadline for the FOURTH time — now TUESDAY 8 PM ET (Wednesday 5:30 AM IST). He called it 'Power Plant Day and Bridge Day, all wrapped in one.' The language was his most aggressive yet: 'Open the F***in' Strait, you crazy bastards, or you'll be living in Hell.' He signed off: 'Praise be to Allah.'

But hours later, he told Fox News there's a 'good chance of a deal by Monday' and announced a White House news conference for Monday 1 PM ET (10:30 PM IST). This creates a binary setup for markets:

IF DEAL ANNOUNCED MONDAY:
• Brent drops to $82-85. Sensex rallies 2,000+. Rupee recovers below 92
• FII reversal begins. VIX crashes. India relief rally
• But Hormuz congestion lasts months. Tolls may be permanent

IF NO DEAL + STRIKES TUESDAY:
• Brent spikes past $130. Sensex crashes 2,000+. Rupee past 95
• Power outages across Iran. Humanitarian crisis. Regional escalation
• India's 60-day fuel buffer starts depleting faster

Overnight: Iran missile hit a residential building in Haifa — 2 killed, 4 wounded, 2 missing. Mahshahr petrochemical hub hit — 5 killed, 170 injured. Iran: 'Hormuz won't reopen until fully compensated for war damage.' Tel Aviv anti-war protest — 1,000+ defied police.

For India (Day 38):
• Green Sanvi arriving MUMBAI TODAY — 46,650 MT LPG
• India OFFICIALLY buying Iranian oil — first time in 7 years
• 9 carriers crossed. 17 ships + 460 seafarers remain
• 60 days stock. LPG 30+ days. Refineries >100%
• USA = #1 LPG supplier. India supplying 5 neighbors
• Markets reopen TOMORROW. Deadline extension = slight positive
• Brent $110.60 — crossing $110 triggers Elara's ₹8-14/L petrol hike estimate

The week ahead is the most consequential since the war began. Monday's news conference will either be the beginning of the end — or the beginning of something much worse.
